items.title: Andrew Ng maps the software fundamentals AI engineers still need
items.summary: Andrew Ng's AI Engineering Skills Map argues that agentic coding raises the value of full-stack judgment, data management, architecture, security, reliability, and production operations.
items.whyItMatters: Coding agents can accelerate implementation, but engineers still own system boundaries, trade-offs, and production consequences.

items.title: DeepLearning.AI puts evaluation loops at the center of reliable AI
items.summary: DeepLearning.AI's engineering skills framework connects model mechanics, grounded data, agentic design, evaluation-driven development, and production reliability into one operating discipline.
items.whyItMatters: Teams need continuous evaluation and iteration to turn probabilistic model behavior into dependable product behavior.

items.title: Debian's community records its vote on LLM and AI use
items.summary: A Debian community megathread consolidates the result and discussion around the project's formal vote on how LLM-generated contributions should be handled.
items.whyItMatters: Open-source projects are turning informal AI concerns into explicit contribution and governance policy.

items.title: A smaller web-search tool arrives for local llama-server setups
items.summary: A LocalLLaMA developer shared a minimal helper that gives llama-server access to a simple web-search tool without requiring a larger orchestration stack.
items.whyItMatters: Smaller tool layers make retrieval-augmented local models easier to inspect, operate, and adapt.

items.title: Pinterest scales conditional retrieval across its home feed
items.summary: Pinterest Engineering describes how Conditional Learned Retrieval expanded to new intent signals while foundation-model training, GPU serving, and a simpler condition interface reduced operational friction.
items.whyItMatters: The work shows how retrieval quality, serving latency, and infrastructure cost must be designed together at production scale.
